rows.transcript_1:
Close your eyes.

Listen to your breath as it goes in and out five times.

Notice how you feel.

When you are ready, open your eyes again. You are in control!
rows.transcript_2:
Tutup mata anda.

Dengar nafas anda keluar dan masuk sebanyak lima kali.

Perhatikan apa yang anda rasa.

Bila anda sudah bersedia, buka semula mata anda. Anda memang mampu mengawalnya!

text_1_facilitator.eng: Today’s skill is about how you can keep control and manage your anger when dealing with stressful moments. 💚

text_2.eng:
🌷Anger is a normal part of everyday life, no matter where you live. So is misbehaving - especially if you are a child!

💙Feeling angry with your child has nothing to do with how much you love them or how good a job you are doing at parenting them.

💡 Learning how to manage your anger can help keep everyone safe.

text_1_facilitator.eng: Here’s a question to help you think about managing these feelings with your child.

quiz_1_question.eng: True or False: When I am angry at my child, I should show that I am angry so that they stop misbehaving.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng:
❌ That’s incorrect. 

💛 Misbehaviour can be difficult, but try to manage your own stress and control your own anger before doing anything. 

🌱 Taking deep breaths will help. Being angry may cause you to say or do things you will later regret.

➡️ You can also redirect or ignore negative behaviour without ignoring your child when they are making you angry.

text_1_facilitator.eng:
Controlling your actions in anger is not easy. 😔

3️⃣ Practising these three steps will help you interact with your child in a more useful way.

rows.text_1_facilitator:
Controlling your actions in anger is not easy. 😔

3️⃣ Practising these three steps will help you interact with your child in a more useful way.

section_1_text.eng:
🌷 Breathe in and out slowly 5 times before speaking or acting. 
☀️ Step away for 10 minutes to regain control of your emotions. A safe outdoor space is a good option!

section_2_text.eng:
🧸 Sometimes anger might come from something else - like being tired, hungry or stressed. 
🌿 Make sure you get enough rest, eat when you are hungry, and find ways to manage stress before it builds up.
💚 Ask someone for support when you are feeling alone.

section_3_text.eng:
☕ Stay connected - talk to friends, family, or other support networks everyday. 💙
❗ Lock away or remove anything dangerous that can be used to hurt others from your home.
🚗 It’s OK to have your children stay somewhere safe while you recover.

quiz_1_question.eng: Here’s a home activity! ⭐ If you start feeling angry today, breathe in and out slowly 5 times before you do anything and notice how you feel. Can you do this today? ⏰

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng: Great! 💙 Be proud of yourself when you manage to control your anger!

quiz_1_feedback_2.eng: That's OK! If you don't have time today, practise controlling any anger you feel tomorrow. You can practise this skill any time you start feeling angry. You are a super parent! 😃
